written.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
written.summary: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Huang took full responsibility in a message to staff, stating he fell short of his duties.

written.headline: Goldman Sachs restricts AI coding tools to engineers and strats
written.summary: Goldman Sachs updated its internal guidance in October to restrict Anthropic's Claude Code and Microsoft's GitHub to its engineering staff and hybrid 'strats', cutting off most traders and bankers. The change follows a review of productivity and risk concerns regarding non-technical employees running code-writing software.

written.headline: DeepSeek says Harness agent app reached 1.54M daily active users
written.summary: DeepSeek reported that its open-source agent application Harness reached 1.54 million daily active users by November 4. The application uses roughly 92 trillion tokens a day, or about 60 million per user.

written.headline: AI companies sell $300B+ in stock in 2026 amid market absorption questions
written.summary: AI companies sold or priced over $300 billion of stock in 2026, with about $100 billion more planned, excluding Anthropic's IPO. This surge follows a sharp tech sell-off that caused Nasdaq composite companies to lose $2.5 trillion in market value on Thursday.

written.headline: Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot
written.summary: Nvidia's board of directors launched an independent investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign spy operation involving former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang. The board stated it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.
